items.title: 5.4.1 Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces (London dispersion forces) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4.1, printed pages 98-100, with Quick Check 5.2 and answers.

blocks.title: Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole force
blocks.text: Ek instantaneous (sirf ek pal ka) dipole aur us se bane induced (paida kiye gaye) dipole ke darmiyan momentary (pal bhar ki) force of attraction (kashish) ko instantaneous dipole-induced dipole force kehte hain.
Non-polar compounds ke molecules ke darmiyan sirf yehi forces hoti hain. In forces ki strength (taqat) neeche diye gaye factors (asar karne wali cheezon) par depend karti hai.
